data.one_liner: Force update, maintenance mode and patch notes via Firebase Remote Config for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: It listens to a Remote Config payload and shows non‑dismissable force‑update dialogs, optional update prompts, maintenance screens, and patch notes. The UI can be built-in or fully custom and reacts in real time.
use_when: You need a single Remote Config payload to control update flow
You want real‑time updates without restarting the app
You need both optional and force updates plus maintenance mode
avoid_when: You already have a custom update system that doesn’t use Firebase Remote Config
You need fine‑grained control over fetch intervals beyond what the package offers
strengths: Supports optional, force, and maintenance modes in one package
Handles patch notes in text or HTML
weaknesses: Only works with Firebase Remote Config
Limited to the provided UI unless fully custom
data.setup_notes: Add firebase_core and firebase_remote_config to pubspec, initialize Firebase in main, call FirebaseUpdate.instance.initialize with navigatorKey and config, ensure Remote Config parameter firebase_update_config is set.

alternatives.name: firebase_remote_config
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use only the Remote Config client and implement your own UI logic
